color.note: Five color layers: warm neutral (bg, surface, border, fg, placeholder) · primary (cobalt) · secondary (neutral fill) · accent (lime) · status (success, warning, danger; info uses primary). Glass material is only for floating chrome. The wire theme is a gray version for wireframes.

tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: Page, slide and article background: warm paper in light, near black in dark.

tokens.name: bg-muted
tokens.usage: Recessed areas: code block body, progress track, table header, tab and segmented trays.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Cards, panels, inputs, diagram nodes: every block that sits on bg.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Floating layer: menu, popover, dialog, toast, selected tab. Lighter than surface in dark.

tokens.name: overlay
tokens.usage: Scrim behind a dialog or sheet.

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Decorative borders and dividers. Never a control border.

tokens.name: border-strong
tokens.usage: Control borders (input, select, checkbox, radio, outline button) and diagram edges. ≥3:1 on bg and surface in every theme.

tokens.name: fg
tokens.usage: Main text on bg, bg-muted, surface, surface-raised, secondary and every *-subtle background.

tokens.name: fg-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, meta, placeholder, captions. ≥4.5:1 on the same backgrounds as fg.

tokens.name: placeholder
tokens.usage: Hint text (placeholder) in inputs. ~4.6:1 on the filled field in all 3 themes: clearly lighter than typed text (fg, ~13–16:1) but still readable. Not for labels or secondary text (use fg-muted).

tokens.name: primary
tokens.usage: Main color: primary buttons, links, focus, selected or running state, information. Works as text on every neutral background and on primary-subtle.

tokens.name: primary-hover
tokens.usage: Hover and active state of the primary button.

tokens.name: primary-subtle
tokens.usage: Light background for a selected state, an info alert, a highlighted row. Text on it: primary or fg.

tokens.name: primary-fg
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a primary background.

tokens.name: secondary
tokens.usage: Secondary color (neutral): secondary buttons, chips, button group and tab trays.

tokens.name: secondary-hover
tokens.usage: Hover of secondary and ghost buttons.

tokens.name: secondary-fg
tokens.usage: Text on secondary.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: A rare highlight: one phrase, one featured bar in a chart, the "New" badge. At most one spot per screen. Never a text color.

tokens.name: accent-fg
tokens.usage: Text on accent.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Success, complete or correct state. Text, icons, and solid fills with primary-fg.

tokens.name: success-subtle
tokens.usage: Light background for success badges and alerts. Text: success or fg.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Warning, needs attention, waiting.

tokens.name: warning-subtle
tokens.usage: Light background for warning badges and alerts.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Errors, failures, destructive actions. Always with words or an icon.

tokens.name: danger-subtle
tokens.usage: Light background for danger badges and alerts, and removed lines in a diff.

tokens.name: glass
tokens.usage: Glass material for floating chrome: topbar, tab bar, toolbar, menu, toast. Goes with the `blur-md` backdrop blur. Not for buttons or inputs. Text: fg.

tokens.name: glass-strong
tokens.usage: Thicker glass when the content behind is busy: dialog, command palette, sheet.

tokens.name: glass-edge
tokens.usage: Inner light border of a glass surface (not for buttons).

tokens.name: hairline
tokens.usage: A 0.5–1px outline around a floating block. Decorative.

tokens.name: inverse
tokens.usage: High-contrast block: tooltip, banner, emphasis slide, user bubble.

tokens.name: inverse-fg
tokens.usage: Main text on inverse.

tokens.name: inverse-fg-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text on inverse (≥5.9:1).

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus ring: solid 2px, 2px offset, only on :focus-visible. ≥3:1 on every background.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: Opening slide title, post cover. At most once per screen.

styles.name: title-2
styles.usage: H2, section title in a slide.

styles.name: lead
styles.sample: One sentence that sums up the whole slide.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Each paragraph makes one point, in short, active sentences.
styles.usage: Main text in posts and cards.

styles.name: body-sm
styles.usage: Descriptions in cards, nodes, lists, long captions.

styles.name: code-sm
styles.usage: Small inline code, technical meta (time, tokens, ids).

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Gap between an icon and text, vertical badge padding.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap inside small groups: badges, meta, buttons.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Padding of nodes, alerts, list items.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding, gap between list items.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Gap between cards, code block padding, space between nodes.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Small slide padding, space between sections.

tokens.name: space-7
tokens.usage: Standard slide padding, post margins.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Large breathing room: between a display title and the content.

radius.note: Concentric corners: a child's radius = the parent's radius − the parent's padding. Controls are capsules. A bar that touches the window edge (topbar) has no rounded corners. A browser that supports corner-shape draws squircles.

tokens.name: radius-xs
tokens.usage: Checkboxes, kbd, inline code, small icon tiles.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Inputs, selects, textareas, menu items, list items, nav items.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Alerts, toasts, code blocks, nodes, menus, small popovers, log and timeline items.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards, tables, panels, stats, checklists, compare.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: Dialogs, sheets, slides, command palette, large page frames.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Capsules: buttons, badges, tags, segmented controls, tabs, tab bars, switches, avatars, progress bars.

shadow.note: Soft shadows; layers come from backgrounds + hairlines. No colored glow under buttons.

tokens.name: shadow-1
tokens.usage: Cards, stats, nodes: a slight lift above bg.

tokens.name: shadow-2
tokens.usage: Menus, popovers, toasts, toolbars, tab bars, an item being dragged or selected.

tokens.name: shadow-3
tokens.usage: Dialogs, sheets, command palette.

tokens.name: stroke-1
tokens.usage: Borders, dividers, secondary diagram edges.

tokens.name: stroke-2
tokens.usage: Diagram edges, node borders.

tokens.name: stroke-3
tokens.usage: Focus ring, main flow, active state.

size.note: Control and icon sizes. All controls in one row use the same step.

tokens.name: control-sm
tokens.usage: Small buttons, inputs, selects: toolbars, tables, inside cards.

tokens.name: control-md
tokens.usage: Default size of buttons, inputs, selects, tabs.

tokens.name: control-lg
tokens.usage: Main CTA, mobile forms, large search field.

tokens.name: icon-sm
tokens.usage: Icons in sm/md buttons, menus, badges.

tokens.name: icon-md
tokens.usage: Icons in lg buttons, sidebar, small empty states.

tokens.name: avatar-md
tokens.usage: Default avatar in lists, messages, tables.

tokens.name: z-sticky
tokens.usage: Topbar, sticky table header.

tokens.name: z-popover
tokens.usage: Menus, popovers, tooltips.

tokens.name: z-modal
tokens.usage: Dialogs, sheets, command palette.

tokens.name: z-toast
tokens.usage: Toasts always stay on top.

tokens.name: opacity-disabled
tokens.usage: Disabled controls.

blur.note: Backdrop blur for the glass material.

tokens.name: blur-sm
tokens.usage: Tooltip.

tokens.name: blur-md
tokens.usage: Topbar, tab bar, toolbar, menu, toast.

tokens.name: blur-lg
tokens.usage: Dialog, sheet, command palette.
